name: @tavrn/desktop-electron
description: The tavrn desktop app for Linux: the Electron shell around the web client (docs/DESKTOP.md "The Linux shell (Electron)")

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && vite build --config vite.preload.config.ts && node scripts/copy-native.mjs
scripts.package: pnpm run build && node scripts/copy-native.mjs --require && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.mjs --linux --publish never
scripts.package:win: pnpm run build && node scripts/copy-native.mjs --require && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.mjs --win --publish never
